description: This file defines a static class 'CosmosIdSanitizer' that provides methods to sanitize and desanitize strings for safe storage or retrieval in Cosmos DB. It handles escaping characters that may be problematic for Cosmos IDs and reconstructs original strings from sanitized versions.

classes.name: CosmosIdSanitizer
classes.description: A static class containing methods for sanitizing and desanitizing strings for Cosmos DB use, handling specific characters with escape sequences.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Replaces problematic characters in input strings with escape sequences suitable for Cosmos DB.

methods.name: Unsanitize
methods.description: Reverts escaped sequences back to their original characters, reconstructing the sanitized string.
